scope: Exploratory CHELSA 21ka vs 0BP climate-only least-cost habitat analogue connectivity pilot; NO new nucleotide identity, genetic distance or genetic effect.
reason_for_selection: 26 frozen original sample localities within 10.455-11.05N, 85.51-85.2804W; a compact native-CHELSA ROI and three recorded accepted host plants. Original species COI status has previously been exposed, so this is NOT independent genetic validation.

raster.grid: use unchanged raster native geotransform and grid resolution; crop to bounding rectangle of frozen 26 sample coordinates plus 0.12 degrees on every side; window snapped OUTWARD to the source grid
raster.nodata: An invalid value in any of the four time-specific bioclim layers yields an impassable cell; no extrapolation or nearest-valid-cell snapping. Both endpoint cells must be finite in BOTH periods.
raster.historical_terrestrial_and_ice_mask: NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_PILOT; raster climate validity is NOT evidence of a true paleocoastline, ice-free land, or a traversable physical landscape

analogues.normalization: mean and population SD across all finite original 0BP WGSRPD3 support climates across four variables, frozen from old materialization algorithm
analogues.host_reference: 3 fixed original accepted host species, native WGSRPD3 unit-union 0BP point cloud; exact nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance in standardized four-var climate space
analogues.self_reference: 0BP standardized climates of the 26 original insect sample localities, finite only; no genetic data
analogues.cell_cost: 1 + nearest-neighbor 4D Euclidean standardized climate distance to host or self reference cloud, positive dimensionless penalty

connectivity.algorithm: undirected Dijkstra on raster nodes with N/S/E/W 4-neighbor edges only
connectivity.edge_weight: haversine great-circle center-to-center length in km times arithmetic mean endpoint cell costs
connectivity.original_edges: exact 64 frozen species locality pairs; no backfill or repaired edges
connectivity.endpoint_mapping: source native raster cell containing exact original (lon,lat); if either cell invalid, pilot is NOT_EVALUABLE; do not snap elsewhere
connectivity.zero_same_grid_cell_edges: keep exact zero raster path as discretization note, never impute a positive path; do not silently log-transform zero
connectivity.derived: delta_host=R_host_LGM-R_host_0BP; delta_self=R_self_LGM-R_self_0BP; unique=delta_host-delta_self in pixel-center cost-km
connectivity.boundary_sensitivity: Pilot fixed ROI only; NO inference on geographic pathways outside bounding box. Future ROI/grid/paleomask sensitivity needs separately disclosed fresh protocol.

verification.frozen_old_five_point_predictor_replay: Recompute existing M_host, D_host_0BP and M_self on all 64 frozen edges by sampling original eight rasters at original great-circle interior fractions; compare to untouched frozen predictor CSV within absolute 1e-8
verification.algorithmic_tests: independent 4-neighbor graph explicit shortest path on toy lattices, off-axis route improvement, invariance to additive scale baseline for uniform grid, ocean/invalid endpoint stop, native window bounds
verification.terminal_failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_CLIMATE_CORRIDOR_PILOT; no threshold/grid/domain adjustments after inspecting outcome
